adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired worker-2 table parsing for EC50, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, genotoxicity, time-kill, and Galleria rows; reconciled all packet-linked DBAASP records against Table 1 and Tables 2-5; and replaced worker-6 mechanism placeholders with bounded source-located phenotype and direct microscopy claims. per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 44 packet-linked DBAASP literature, assay, and experiment rows are source-reviewed. Table 1 supports peptide identity/sequence; Tables 2-5 support activity, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, and genotoxicity rows; article metadata supports DOI/PMID/PMCID traceability. Table 1 peptide sequence, parent-protein, GRAVY, pI, molecular-mass, and charge values are preserved as primary-source identity records.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity evidence preserves endpoint, raw value, raw unit, target species/strain, assay conditions, and locator for 70 source-supported rows. Prior unresolved Table 3/4 parser issues are closed; no database-only row is treated as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology separates phenotype evidence from direct microscopy. TEM/SEM/confocal are direct mechanism evidence for cellular damage/internalization; CD in SDS remains inferred/model-membrane support; in vivo Galleria survival is phenotype evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: The local supplement is one PDF with Figure S1 text. It supports qualitative apoptosis-profile context only; raw quadrant percentages are not locally available and are not fabricated.
